basic_details.job_title: BECIL Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 5 Project Manager, Engineer and More Posts
basic_details.total_vacancies: Senior Project Manager, Project Manager – Bidding, Project Engineer, Project Executive, Project Assistant
basic_details.post_name: Corporate Office, Noida / Head Office (may be posted anywhere in India)
basic_details.short_information: Broadcast Engineering Consultants India Limited (BECIL), a Mini Ratna Government of India enterprise under the Ministry of Information & Broadcasting, has released dated 20 November 2026. Under BECIL Recruitment 2026, the company is engaging candidates for 5 posts purely on a contract basis: Senior Project Manager, Project Manager – Bidding, Project Engineer, Project Executive and Project Assistant. The current place of posting is BECIL's Corporate Office in Noida, although candidates may be posted anywhere in India based on official requirements.

qualification.details: Nationality: Only Indian nationals are eligible. Age limit: Upper age limit as on March 2026 is 50 years (SSIT-001, SSIT-002), 40 years (SSIT-003), 45 years (SSIT-004) and 35 years (SSIT-005). The notification does not mention any age relaxation. Health and integrity: Candidates must be physically and mentally fit, must not be accused in any pending inquiry and must be of impeccable integrity. Previous engagement: Candidates previously engaged by BECIL or the client whose services were terminated, discontinued or not renewed due to disciplinary action, misconduct, unsatisfactory performance or contract violation are not eligible. | Senior Project Manager: overall supervision of projects, planning and monitoring, coordination with clients, Government officials, OEMs and vendors, business development meetings, MIS reports. Project Manager – Bidding: end-to-end bid management on GeM, CPPP and e-Procurement portals, preparing technical and commercial bids, tracking tender schedules and corrigenda, bid MIS reports. Project Engineer: technical execution support, supervision of installation, commissioning and testing, site visits and inspections, technical reports and project documentation. Project Executive: day-to-day coordination of ongoing projects, client and vendor coordination, MIS and status reports, support to Project Managers. Project Assistant: data entry, Excel sheets and reports, digitisation of records, tender documentation and office support.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 35,000 – Rs. 55,000 per month (Project Assistant: as per minimum wages)
salary_details.details: Pay is consolidated. No allowances such as DA, HRA, residential telephone, transport facility/allowance, CGHS or medical reimbursement are admissible. Tax is deducted as per applicable rules. TA/DA is allowed for official outstation travel within India as per company rules. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview, document verification or for joining.

selection_process: Shortlisting: applications are screened on credentials and suitability for the post

using pre-approved criteria. Interview: shortlisted candidates are called for an interview in virtual or physical mode. Only shortlisted candidates are informed. Screening-cum-Selection Committee: a committee set up by BECIL selects candidates. Candidates present their original credentials (experience
suitability) during the interview. Final selection: based on qualifications
suitability for the post and interview performance. Document verification: candidature stays provisional until original documents for age
experience and category are verified. Selected candidates must submit a Police Verification Report.
how_to_apply: Visit the BECIL registration portal becilregistration.in.
Click New Registration and fill in your personal details to register.
Log in and complete the remaining application details for the post you want.
Upload the documents required for the post's eligibility criteria.
Pay the application processing fee online (if applicable).
Submit the application and save or print the application receipt once payment succeeds.
The fee is non-refundable and non-transferable. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application and fee for each post.
Last date: 5 December 2026, 11:59 PM. Late applications are rejected, and no request to extend the date will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: BECIL Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The number of vacancies is tentative and may increase or decrease depending on the requirements of the client/principal employer.

content_sections.heading: BECIL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Nationality: Only Indian nationals are eligible. Age limit: Upper age limit as on March 2026 is 50 years (SSIT-001, SSIT-002), 40 years (SSIT-003), 45 years (SSIT-004) and 35 years (SSIT-005). The notification does not mention any age relaxation. Health and integrity: Candidates must be physically and mentally fit, must not be accused in any pending inquiry and must be of impeccable integrity. Previous engagement: Candidates previously engaged by BECIL or the client whose services were terminated, discontinued or not renewed due to disciplinary action, misconduct, unsatisfactory performance or contract violation are not eligible. Senior Project Manager: overall supervision of projects, planning and monitoring, coordination with clients, Government officials, OEMs and vendors, business development meetings, MIS reports. Project Manager – Bidding: end-to-end bid management on GeM, CPPP and e-Procurement portals, preparing technical and commercial bids, tracking tender schedules and corrigenda, bid MIS reports. Project Engineer: technical execution support, supervision of installation, commissioning and testing, site visits and inspections, technical reports and project documentation. Project Executive: day-to-day coordination of ongoing projects, client and vendor coordination, MIS and status reports, support to Project Managers. Project Assistant: data entry, Excel sheets and reports, digitisation of records, tender documentation and office support.

rows.qualification: Bachelor's degree in ECE, EE, IT or CSE, or MCA, or an equivalent engineering qualification from a recognised university/institution, and MBA/PGDM in Project Management / Operations / Marketing or a related discipline (required)
Graduate in BCA, MCA, B.Tech, B.E. or equivalent. Working knowledge of GeM Portal, CPPP Portal and Government e-Procurement systems is compulsory

Bachelor's degree or diploma in ECE, EE, IT, CSE, Electronics Engineering or an equivalent discipline from a recognised university/institution. Certifications in Networking, CCTV Systems, IT Infrastructure, Surveillance Systems, Data Centre Operations or Project Management are preferred
Diploma in ECE, EE, IT, CSE or an equivalent discipline, or BCA, from a recognised university/institution. MBA/PGDM is desirable
Graduate from a recognised university with proficiency in MS Office applications

rows.experience: Minimum 5 years in project management, operations, business development, Government tender coordination or related fields. Experience in Government/PSU projects and end-to-end project lifecycle management preferred, plus client coordination and project execution
Minimum cumulative 3 years in bid management, GeM operations, CPPP support activities and Government e-Procurement systems, including preparation and submission of technical and commercial bids

Minimum 3 years in project implementation, technical operations, system integration, surveillance systems, IT infrastructure, networking or related fields; experience with Government/PSU projects, installation, commissioning, testing, troubleshooting and maintenance, and technical documentation. Site coordination experience preferred
Minimum 5 years in project coordination, operations management, client coordination, business development support or related activities. Government/PSU project experience preferred

content_sections.heading: BECIL Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Pay is consolidated. No allowances such as DA, HRA, residential telephone, transport facility/allowance, CGHS or medical reimbursement are admissible. Tax is deducted as per applicable rules. TA/DA is allowed for official outstation travel within India as per company rules. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview, document verification or for joining.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BECIL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the BECIL registration portal becilregistration.in . Click New Registration and fill in your personal details to register. Log in and complete the remaining application details for the post you want. Upload the documents required for the post's eligibility criteria. Pay the application processing fee online (if applicable). Submit the application and save or print the application receipt once payment succeeds. The fee is non-refundable and non-transferable. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application and fee for each post . Last date: 5 December 2026, 11:59 PM. Late applications are rejected, and no request to extend the date will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Proof of age (date of birth) Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets (degree/diploma, MBA/PGDM where required) Experience certificates covering the required years and fields Certifications (Networking, CCTV, IT infrastructure, etc.), if claimed for Project Engineer Category certificate (SC/ST/PwD) to claim the fee exemption A valid, active email ID and mobile number Police Verification Report (PVR): to be submitted at document verification after selection, or within one month of joining Shortlisted candidates must bring original documents plus one set of self-attested photocopies to the document verification or interview.

content_sections.heading: BECIL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisting: applications are screened on credentials and suitability for the post, using pre-approved criteria. Interview: shortlisted candidates are called for an interview in virtual or physical mode. Only shortlisted candidates are informed. Screening-cum-Selection Committee: a committee set up by BECIL selects candidates. Candidates present their original credentials (experience, achievements, suitability) during the interview. Final selection: based on qualifications, experience, suitability for the post and interview performance. Document verification: candidature stays provisional until original documents for age, qualification, experience and category are verified. Selected candidates must submit a Police Verification Report.
